source: A Daily Prayer
Holy Spirit, fill me!
Pray for the Holy Spirit to work in you and through you.
target: Thandaza kutsi moya loyingcwele asebente kuwe, ngawe.

source: Jesus, protect me!
Put yourself under the protection of Jesus' blood and sacrifice.
Heavenly Father, give me whatever gift I need today.
target: Babe waseZulwini, ngiphe tonkhe tipho lengitidzingako namuhla.

source: God can give you everything you'll need this day.
Thank you, God, for my life and everything you're giving me.
target: Ngiyabonga, Nkulunkulu imphilo nako konkhe longipha kona.

source: Say thanks in and for everything.
target: Bonga ngato konkhe putsi kuko konkhe.

source: Put on the whole armor of God
Helmet of Salvation
God, protect and change my thoughts.
target: Nkulunkulu yengamela futsi ushintje imicabango yami.

source: Breastplate of Righteousness
Thank you, God, for your grace by which I'm saved.
target: Ngiyabonga nkulunkulu umusa wakho, le-ngawo ngisindzisiwe.

source: Belt of Truth
God, help me to speak truth and to live according to your truth.
target: Nkulunkulu, ngisite ngikhulume liciniso futsi ngiphile ngeliciniso.

source: Shoes of Readiness
God, help me to see situations where I can share about you and help me to do it.
target: Nkulunkulu, ngisite kutsi ngibone timo lapho kubalulekile ngishumayele ngawe, futsi ngisite ngishumuyele ngawe.

source: Shield of Faith
God I trust you. Let my faith in you grow.
target: Nkulunkulu ngiyakwetsemba. Kukholwa kwami akwandze kuwe.

source: Sword / God's Word
God, help me to understand your word better and to use it.
target: Nkulunkulu, ngisite ngicondze livi lakho kancono bese ngiyalisebentisa.

source: (Ephesians 6:10-17)
